question: Identify the artist with the highest overall sales of albums (tie broken by alphabetical order) and the artist with the lowest overall sales of albums (tie broken by alphabetical order), then calculate the amount each customer spent specifically on those two artists’ albums. Next, compute the average spending for the customers who purchased from the top-selling artist and the average spending for the customers who purchased from the lowest-selling artist, and finally return the absolute difference between these two averages.
sql:
WITH artist_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        a.ArtistId,
        a.Name AS ArtistName,
        SUM(ii.UnitPrice * ii.Quantity) AS TotalSales
    FROM albums al
    JOIN artists a ON al.ArtistId = a.ArtistId
    JOIN tracks t ON al.AlbumId = t.AlbumId
    JOIN invoice_items ii ON t.TrackId = ii.TrackId
    GROUP BY a.ArtistId, a.Name
),
ranked_artists AS (
    SELECT 
        ArtistId,
        ArtistName,
        TotalSales,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY TotalSales DESC, ArtistName ASC) AS rn_top,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY TotalSales ASC, ArtistName ASC) AS rn_bottom
    FROM artist_sales
),
top_artist AS (
    SELECT ArtistId FROM ranked_artists WHERE rn_top = 1
),
bottom_artist AS (
    SELECT ArtistId FROM ranked_artists WHERE rn_bottom = 1
),
customer_spending AS (
    SELECT 
        i.CustomerId,
        i.Total AS InvoiceTotal,
        al.ArtistId,
        CASE 
            WHEN al.ArtistId = (SELECT ArtistId FROM top_artist) THEN i.Total
            WHEN al.ArtistId = (SELECT ArtistId FROM bottom_artist) THEN i.Total
            ELSE 0
        END AS ArtistSpent
    FROM invoices i
    JOIN invoice_items ii ON i.InvoiceId = ii.InvoiceId
    JOIN tracks t2 ON ii.TrackId = t2.TrackId
    JOIN albums al ON t2.AlbumId = al.AlbumId
    WHERE al.ArtistId IN (SELECT ArtistId FROM top_artist UNION SELECT ArtistId FROM bottom_artist)
    GROUP BY i.CustomerId, i.Total, al.ArtistId
),
artist_customer_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        ArtistId,
        SUM(ArtistSpent) AS TotalSpent,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CustomerId) AS CustomerCount,
        AVG(ArtistSpent) AS AvgSpending
    FROM customer_spending
    GROUP BY ArtistId
)
SELECT 
    (SELECT AvgSpending FROM artist_customer_totals WHERE ArtistId = (SELECT ArtistId FROM top_artist)) AS top_avg,
    (SELECT AvgSpending FROM artist_customer_totals WHERE ArtistId = (SELECT ArtistId FROM bottom_artist)) AS bottom_avg,
    ABS(
        (SELECT AvgSpending FROM artist_customer_totals WHERE ArtistId = (SELECT ArtistId FROM top_artist)) -
        (SELECT AvgSpending FROM artist_customer_totals WHERE ArtistId = (SELECT ArtistId FROM bottom_artist))
    ) AS avg_difference
